column1: # comment: "logic:\u2194Common Logic bridge (by reference). The canonical logic: IR is a first-order superset that operationalizes ISO/IEC 24707 Common Logic as ingested and emitted CLIF, CGIF, and XCL dialects; this set links the logic: terms that have a stable external counterpart to the Common Logic Wikidata anchor (Q5153563 \u2014 'framework for a family of logic languages'). closeMatch/relatedMatch, never equivalence: logic: is broader than CL, and the projection target is a rendering request over the IR, not the framework itself. The ISO/IEC 24707 document has no RDF namespace and is cited in the citation ledger (metadata/references.ttl) rather than aligned as a term."

# # REFUSED (Principle 5 — no stable RDF namespace): ISO/IEC 24707 Common Logic publishes no RDF/OWL vocabulary for its abstract-syntax categories (text, phrase, sentence, term, name-sequence, module), so those cannot be aligned as terms; the standard is cited in metadata/references.ttl and operationalized by the CLIF/CGIF/XCL codecs.

# # REFUSED (Principle 5 — no stable external entity): the individual CLIF / CGIF / XCL dialects, the Common Logic importation directive (cl-imports), and the sequence-marker construct (logic:SequenceMarker, the CL '…x' form) have no stable Wikidata/RDF entity to align to; recorded rather than aligned to a fabricated IRI. CGIF's conceptual-graph heritage (wd:Q1420493) and CLIF's KIF ancestry (wd:Q354163) are relations between the standards, not gmeow term counterparts, so they are noted here rather than minted as cells.

column6: logic:CommonLogicProjection is the projection target that renders an answer onto the ISO/IEC 24707 Common Logic surface; wd:Q5153563 (Common Logic) is the framework it targets. closeMatch, not equivalence: the projection target is a standing rendering request over the canonical logic: IR, not the CL framework itself.

logic:Module is the Common Logic theory/module construct onto which the ingested and emitted CLIF, CGIF, and XCL (module …) and (cl-imports …) forms map; relatedMatch to wd:Q5153563 (Common Logic) — a component construct of the framework, not the framework as a whole. No stable external entity names a CL module/text on its own.
